title: Robust Photoplethysmography Signal Denoising via Mamba Networks
abstract: arXiv:2510.11058v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely used in wearable health monitoring, but its reliability is often degraded by noise and motion artifacts, limiting downstream applications such as heart rate (HR) estimation. This paper presents a deep learning framework for PPG denoising with an emphasis on preserving physiological information. In this framework, we propose DPNet, a Mamba-based denoising backbone designed for effective temporal modeling. To further enhance denoising performance, the framework also incorporates a scale-invariant signal-to-distortion ratio (SI-SDR) loss to promote waveform fidelity and an auxiliary HR predictor (HRP) that provides physiological consistency through HR-based supervision. Experiments on the BIDMC dataset show that our method achieves strong robustness against both synthetic noise and real-world motion artifacts, outperforming conventional filtering and existing neural models. translated_title: 基于Mamba网络的鲁棒光电容积脉搏波信号去噪
translated_abstract: 光电容积脉搏波（PPG）技术广泛应用于可穿戴健康监测，但其可靠性常因噪声和运动伪影而下降，限制了心率（HR）估计等下游应用。本文提出了一种强调保留生理信息的PPG去噪深度学习框架。在该框架中，我们提出了DPNet，一种基于Mamba的去噪主干网络，旨在实现有效的时间序列建模。为进一步提升去噪性能，该框架还引入了尺度不变信号失真比（SI-SDR）损失以促进波形保真度，以及一个辅助心率预测器（HRP），通过基于心率的监督提供生理一致性。在BIDMC数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法对合成噪声和真实世界运动伪影均表现出强大的鲁棒性，性能优于传统滤波方法和现有神经模型。
tldr: 本文提出基于Mamba网络的DPNet去噪框架，结合SI-SDR损失与辅助心率预测器，在保留生理信息的同时实现鲁棒的PPG信号去噪，性能超越传统滤波和现有神经模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DPNet, a Mamba-based PPG denoising framework incorporating SI-SDR loss and an auxiliary heart rate predictor, achieving robust signal denoising while preserving physiological information and outperforming conventional filtering and existing neural models.
